headline: New Hybrid Supercar Owner Still Forced to Wait for Local Tea Stall to Finish Brewing Chai
body:
The owner of the newly unveiled 1,050bhp hybrid supercar was spotted idling his V12 engine for forty-five minutes on Thursday morning while waiting for a roadside vendor to finish brewing a fresh batch of masala chai. Despite the vehicle's ability to reach triple-digit speeds in under three seconds, the driver remained trapped in a stationary queue behind a fleet of three-wheelers.

"The engineering is marvelously efficient, and the hybrid integration is seamless, but unfortunately, it doesn't account for the thermal dynamics of milk simmering in an open-air clay pot," said a spokesperson for the local car club. "The car can harness the power of a lightning bolt, but it remains fundamentally powerless against a vendor who is currently busy washing a single glass with a rag."

Witnesses noted that the supercar’s advanced aerodynamics offered little protection from the localized traffic congestion caused by the tea stall’s popularity. The driver reportedly turned off his engine to save fuel, effectively turning his multi-crore investment into an extremely expensive, low-slung park bench for the duration of the wait.
caption: Efficiency has its limits when faced with the morning chai rush. Even 1,050bhp can't expedite a slow kettle. #Supercar #ChaiLife #DailyCommute #RoadsideReality (satire)
imagePrompt: A photorealistic shot of a high-end luxury sports car parked on a dusty urban roadside, with a small, rustic street-side tea stall visible in the foreground.
